data.text:
Subrata Saha & Ors vs Food Safety & Standard Authority Of ... 
on 31 January, 2024
31.01.2024
Item No.4
Court No.550
Saswata
 W.P.A. 13167 of 2012
 Subrata Saha & Ors.
 -vs-
 Food Safety & Standard Authority of India & Ors.
 Mr. Siddhartha Sankar Mandal
 Ms. Anjana Mehbub
 Ms. Arunima Das Sharma
 ...For the petitioners
 Ms. Manika Roy
 ...For the Fssai
 Mr. Nandala Singhania
 ...For the respondent nos. 4 & 5
1.  Ms. Roy, learned advocate appearing for the FSSAI, by placing before this Court certain option forms exercised by the petitioners, claims that most of the petitioners have already exercised the option either to continue as employees of the Central Government or become an employees of the FSSAI. Copies of such forms have also been made over to the learned advocate appearing for the petitioners. 
2. Having regard to the aforesaid, I grant leave to Ms. Roy to bring on record the aforesaid documents by filing a supplementary affidavit. Let such affidavit be filed on or before 5th February 2024. 
3. List this matter on 7th February 2024. 
(Raja Basu Chowdhury, J.)
